name: – Johan Van Overtveldt – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on digital assets – challenges for the competitiveness and integrity of the European Union’s financial system
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on digital assets such as crypto-assets, stablecoins and tokenised financial instruments. It is an opinion, not a law: it asks the European Commission to enforce existing crypto rules properly, to look at whether lending, borrowing and staking of crypto need rules, and to support tokenisation and a digital euro. It also calls for stronger action against money laundering and closer international cooperation.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** EU regulators, crypto firms, banks and payment providers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on these requests.
